title: LEGO Leak Reveals First Look at Upcoming Dragon Ball Set
content: A new leak has revealed the first glimpse at LEGO’s upcoming Dragon Ball lineup of products. After months of rumors, LE G O confirmed earlier this month in a short teaser trailer that it would soon be collaborating with the storied anime series.
author: ComicBook

title: Jujutsu Kaisen Season 4 Confirms Next Major Update Is Coming Soon
content: Jujutsu Kaisen is now hard at work on the anime’s return for its fourth season, and has thankfully confirmed that the next major update for the new episodes is coming our way soon.
author: ComicBook

title: Black Clover Season 2 Reveals New Pre-Premiere Visual Ahead of October 3 Return
content: Black Clover Season 2 anime has revealed a new pre-premiere visual ahead of its October 3, 2026 premiere. Episode 1 is titled “War Begins,” with the synopsis and preview images available.
author: Anime Corner

title: Live-Action Street Fighter Film Previews Ken vs. Ryu Rivalry in New Trailer
content: Paramount Pictures started streaming a new trailer for Legendary Entertainment 's live-action film of CAPCOM 's Street Fighter game series on Monday, focusing on Ken and Ryu's relationship and rivalry.
author: ANN

title: Crunchyroll’s Solo Leveling Replacement Drops New Release Ahead of Finale
content: While the Solo Leveling movie is still a while away , fans were able to fill the void this Summer 2026 season with the debut of Tomb Raider King . The anime grabbed attention for sharing striking similarities with Solo Leveling even before its premiere.
author: ComicBook

title: Avatar: Seven Havens Confirms First Episode Titles Ahead of October Premiere
content: Avatar: Seven Havens is gearing up to kick off a whole new era of Avatar: The Last Airbender later this October, and the new animated series has confirmed the first few episode titles ahead of its big premiere.
author: ComicBook

title: The Simpsons Movie Sequel Gets Surprising Update Ahead of 2027 Release
content: The Simpsons is now in the works on a new sequel feature film hitting the big screen over 20 years after the release of the first film , and one producer behind it all has shared a surprising update as to how it’s all coming along so far .
author: ComicBook

title: Stalled Despera Anime Project Gets Manga
content: Chiaki J. Konaka (series script supervisor of Serial Experiments Lain , Texhnolyze , and Hellsing ) announced at the Japan Weekend Madrid event in Spain last weekend that Yoshitoshi ABe 's (creator and character designer for Serial Experiments Lain and Haibane Renmei ) Despera anime project is getting a manga in 2027.
author: ANN

title: Studio Ghibli’s Greatest Classics Return With New Look Ahead of a Major Project
content: Studio Ghibli is the most iconic animation studio known for its classic films that are appreciated to this day. The studio was established in 1985, and since then, every film it has released is praised for its striking visuals, rich storytelling, and deep emotional impact.
author: ComicBook

title: Naruto’s Live-Action Movie Might Be Adapting One of the Anime’s First Big Missions: Report
content: Naruto is now in the works on a new live-action feature film, and a new report suggests that this new outing could be adapting one of the anime and manga’s first big missions for its story. Masashi Kishimoto’s Naruto has been long in the works on a proper comeback for the franchises over the last few years.
author: ComicBook
